# CasaRay V3 — view inventory

Every V2 view has a V3 home. `native` = rebuilt from `src/casaray_v3/views/`; `carried` = the V2 view verbatim, links rewritten to the V3 url_path, still on the `CasaRay` theme and the V2 `input_boolean.chinese_dashboard` toggle; `classic` = the original V2 view kept as a `v2-<path>` subview beside its native rebuild, so no V2 function is lost while the rebuild matures.
